info.title: API.SH: Leboncoin
info.description: The Leboncoin API from API.SH: public Leboncoin data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Your balance, usage, logs and past responses. Free.

get.summary: Balance, plan, spend and spend limits

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Your calls of the last 30 days
get.description: Newest first. Filter by status, route prefix, key or time; page with `before` (the `next` value). Add output=csv|ndjson to download (up to 5,000 rows per request; the next cursor is in the x-next-cursor header). Free.

parameters.name: status

parameters.name: key

parameters.name: since

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Cursor from `next`.

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
Leboncoin's category tree as its search uses it: each top category with its subcategories (id, name, slug, parent id, mirror flag, ad types such as offer or demand). Use the ids as `category` in /leboncoin/v1/search. With `regions=true`, also every region with its departments (id, name, slug) for the location filter.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/leboncoin-categories

parameters.name: regions
parameters.description: Also list the regions and their departments.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Leboncoin classified ads for a search, with optional filters: category, price range, sort order and one location (a region, a department, a city with or without its postcode, or a radius around a point). Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 2 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/leboncoin-search

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Leboncoin category id (the `category_id` of an ad), e.g. 55 for bikes.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Minimum price in whole euros.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Maximum price in whole euros.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order of results (default relevance). Boosted ads can still appear first.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Leboncoin region id, e.g. 12 for Ile-de-France. Use only one of region, department or city.

parameters.name: department
parameters.description: French department number, e.g. 75, 69 or 2A.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City name, e.g. Lyon. Required with zipcode or radius.

parameters.name: zipcode
parameters.description: Five-digit postcode of the city, e.g. 69003 (with city).

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in km (1-200) around latitude/longitude; needs city, latitude and longitude.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Centre latitude for radius (decimal degrees).

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Centre longitude for radius (decimal degrees).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A leboncoin search URL (instead of q).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A professional seller's Leboncoin shop and its ads: shop id and name, user id, slogan, description, website, SIREN and SIRET, activity sector, active since, address, city, department, region and coordinates, opening hours, logo, cover and pictures, rating (value, count, source), reply time, last activity, badges, and one page of its ads (id, title, price, category, status, publication, update and expiry dates, location, description, images, attributes, link; `raw` per ad). Private sellers' profiles are not offered. Pass `next_page` back as `page` (null on the last page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/leboncoin-seller

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The shop page (https://www.leboncoin.fr/boutique/<id>) or the seller's profile page (https://www.leboncoin.fr/profil/<user id>).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The shop id, instead of `url`.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: The seller's user id (`owner_id` of an ad from /leboncoin/v1/search), instead of `url`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page of the seller's ads (default 1).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Ads per page, 1 to 35 (default 10).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order of the ads (default: the shop's own order).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
